purpose: Teach: キューブ/シグナル/ダイアリー/グリップ/トラフィック/ブレイク/追伸/フォーカス

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、キューブ型の防犯ボックスを設置されますね
lines.en: The police install cube-shaped security boxes, don't they?
lines.style: Warm, conversational observation. Light upward lilt on the question tag. Steady pace, genuine curiosity without pressing. Leaning into the detail as if noticing something admirable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、緊急シグナルへの即応をされますね
lines.en: The police respond immediately to emergency signals, don't they?
lines.style: Same rhythm as before. Slight emphasis on "immediately" — nodding recognition of the speed required. Still collaborative in tone, not challenging.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、勤務ダイアリーを記録されますね
lines.en: The police keep duty diaries on record, don't they?
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact. The cadence of someone following a thought aloud. Slight pause before the tag, like checking the logic. Steady, unhurried.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、銃のグリップ整備もされますね
lines.en: The police maintain their gun equipment too, don't they?
lines.style: Brief pause after "too" — noticing the breadth of what they do. Warm, almost impressed. Gentle downward curve on the tag. No judgment, just recognition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、交通トラフィックを管理されますね
lines.en: The police manage traffic flow, don't they?
lines.style: Quicker tempo here. Matter-of-fact, like ticking through a list. Still warm underneath. Light energy on "traffic" — the visible work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、休憩ブレイクも適切に取られますね
lines.en: The police take their breaks properly too, don't they?
lines.style: Softer here. Caring observation. Slight smile in the voice. The recognition that even necessary work needs rest. Gentle trailing on the tag.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査報告の末尾に追伸を添えられますね
lines.en: The police add a postscript to their investigation reports, don't they?
lines.style: A beat slower. Specific, almost amusing detail — the formality of it. Warm and slightly conspiratorial, like noticing a human touch in procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査のフォーカスを重大事件に絞られますね
lines.en: The police focus their investigations on major crimes, don't they?
lines.style: Firmer here. More direct. The shift is clear — this one carries weight. Still not lecturing, but the ease drops slightly. Recognition of priority and seriousness.
